title: Caravaggio opening, Centraal Museum
excerpt: Projection work for the opening night of the Caravaggio exhibition at the Centraal Museum in Utrecht.
description:
For the opening of the Caravaggio exhibition at the Centraal Museum in Utrecht, in December 2018, I made the projection mapping and the content.
> Caravaggio built his paintings out of light falling into darkness, so the projections worked the same way: the museum lit only where the light chose to land, and the rest of the room left to the dark.
credits: Projection mapping & content: Jaco Schilp, with LiGHT-UP Collective. Centraal Museum, Utrecht, December 2018. Camera: Jokko Voogt. Edit: Ajehna Rustveld.
